Name: Lockpicks
Author: Mizzion
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dzUmZOq.gif[/img][size=1][/size][/center]
[size=4][b][code][/code][/b][/size][size=4][b][font=Trebuchet MS][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/gyQDU7s.png[/img][/center][center][/center][/font][/b][/size][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b]Lockpicks [/b][/size][size=3]lets you attempt to pick your way through locked doors. It will allow you to access locations early, referring to both time of day, and progression-wise. (As such, it could be considered somewhat unbalanced.) Curious? Missing your favorite NPC? Or just want to buy some seeds on a Wednesday? This could be the mod for you![/size][/font][/font][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/JZgEpO1.png[/img][/u][/size][size=3][u]﻿
[/u][/size][/center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img] [color=#71FF78][b]Multiplayer Compatible![/b][/color][/size][size=3]
[size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img] Multi-lingual! It should support every language the game supports. Uses some machine translations (for now), if you have a correction or suggestion please post it and I'll get it merged in.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img] Lockpicks work on most bedroom doors, exterior doors, and even a few special doors (like the sewer grate).

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img] Once a lock is picked, it will remain unlocked for all players for the rest of the day.[/size]
[/size][size=3]
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img] Lockpicks have a very small chance of breaking on use.[/size][/size]

[center][size=3]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/Tj4bPDU.png[/img]
﻿[/center][size=3][size=3][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img]﻿ [/size]Decompress and drag the contained mod folder into your [font=Courier New][b]/Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b][/font] folder. [/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img]﻿ Purchase a lockpick from Clint (More places can be added).

[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/ngHd1zP.png[/img] With the lockpick in your inventory, interacting with a locked door will provide a prompt offering the use of a lockpick.[/size]
[/size][size=3]


The mod is now fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098] Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. 

[b]As of Version 4.0.1[/b]:

There are new things that must be translated, If you use a different language, the new keys are there, they will just be in English. If you translate them and make a comment, I will add them to the next update.

The following can be edited to change the way the mod works.

[b]Sell Price[/b]: [i]The price when the lock pick is sold. [b]coming soon[/b][/i]
[b]Buy Price[/b]: [i]The price when you buy the lock pick from a store.[/i]
[b]Failure Chance[/b]: [i]The chance that lock picking will fail, Its on a scale of 1 - 100[/b][/i]
[b]Bypass the Sell Modifier[/b]: [i]Set whether or not the stores will use their sell modifier. Example would be Pierre, he charges 2x the buy price.[/i]

If you would like to add lock picks to more stores, there is now console commands to do so.

[i]Type these in the black console box that pops up when you launch the game.
[/i]
Commands:
[b]lockpick_addshop [i]StoreName[/i][/b]: WIll add the lockpicks to the given store. You can get valid store names by using the following command.
[b]lockpick_listshops[/b]: Will list all valid shop names that you can use to add lock picks to.


[/size][center][size=3]
[b]
Thanks for checking out this mod! ﻿❤️ We hope you enjoy it as much as we do.
